approved.title: KICD CBC LESSON PLAN
approved.subtitle: Grade 1 Creative Arts (CAS) - Drawing and Painting
approved.subject: CAS

sections.heading: 1. Administrative Details
items: School: Bahari Girls Junior School
Teacher: Ms. A. Akinyi
Learning Area: Creative Arts (CAS)
Grade/Class: Grade 1
Term: Term 1
Strand: Creating and Performing in Creative Arts
Sub-strand: Drawing and Painting
Duration: 35 Minutes
Date: 24th October 2024

sections.heading: 2. Specific Learning Outcomes
sections.body: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to:
items: Knowledge: Identify basic geometric shapes (circles, squares, triangles) used to draw familiar everyday objects.
Skill: Draw and paint a simple picture of a familiar object using crayons and water-based paints within given boundaries.
Attitude: Value neatness and appreciate own and peers' artwork during the classroom display session.

sections.heading: 3. Key Inquiry Questions
items: 1. What simple shapes can you see in objects found around our classroom?
2. How do colors make our drawings look realistic and beautiful?

sections.heading: 4. Core Competencies
items: Creativity and Imagination: Learners experiment with shapes and vibrant colors to produce unique art pieces.
Communication and Collaboration: Learners share painting tools and talk about their drawings in groups.
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Learners select appropriate shapes and color choices for their chosen objects.

sections.heading: 5. Values
items: Unity: Working together harmoniously and sharing paint jars and brushes.
Responsibility: Caring for art materials and cleaning up work areas after painting.
Respect: Appreciating the diverse creative efforts made by peers.

sections.heading: 6. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs)
items: Environmental Awareness: Proper management of paper waste and safe disposal of paint water.
Health and Safety: Safe handling of non-toxic painting materials and personal hygiene (handwashing after class).

sections.heading: 7. Learning Resources
items: KICD Approved Grade 1 Creative Arts Teacher's Guide and Learner's Workbook
Drawing papers, HB pencils, crayons, non-toxic water-based paints, paintbrushes, water pots, rags
Wall charts showing basic shapes and sample completed drawings of simple objects (ball, apple, house)

sections.heading: 8. Organisation of Learning
items: Phase 1: Introduction (5 Minutes) - Teacher greets learners and leads a short shape-identification game around the classroom. Teacher introduces the lesson focus and asks the key inquiry question.

Phase 2: Lesson Development / Main Activity (20 Minutes) - Step 1 (5 min): Teacher demonstrates drawing a simple shape (a circle turning into an apple) and applying paint inside the lines. Step 2 (10 min): Learners individually draw a simple object using pencils and apply colors using crayons or water paints. Step 3 (5 min): Teacher moves around guiding brush control, color boundaries, and safe tool usage.

Phase 3: Conclusion & Reflection (10 Minutes) - Learners place their finished artwork on the classroom art line/gallery wall. Selected learners describe their drawings to the class. Teacher leads class cleanup (washing brushes, storing paints, washing hands).

sections.heading: 9. Assessment Methods
items: Direct Observation: Assessment of learner engagement, tool handling, and safe paint application.
Oral Questioning: Testing learner understanding of shape names and color choices.
Portfolio / Work Sample Assessment: Rubric-based evaluation of shape accuracy, neatness of painting, and completion.

sections.heading: 10. Teacher's Post-Lesson Reflection
items: Number of learners who successfully achieved the learning outcomes: ____ out of ____.
Learner challenges observed: (e.g., control of paint thickness, staying within boundaries).
Remedial/Follow-up action: Plan fine-motor guidance for learners who struggled with paintbrush control.
